sections.heading: Overview
content: This policy outlines Humana’s billing requirements and reimbursement for home health notice of admission (NOA) submissions.

sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. For home health agency claims: • Humana does not require an NOA for home health services. • Humana does not apply a reduction or penalty for a home health agency’s failure to submit an NOA . • Humana denies an NOA as informational when received. • Humana applies consolidated billing for home health services. Humana does not reimburse separately for services that are part of home health packaged reimbursement, even when those services are billed separately. • Humana requires a provider to report a final claim with an accurate Health Insurance Prospective Payment System (HIPPS) code, as determined by the Outcome and Assessment Information Set (OASIS), for each home health case.

sections.heading: Additional Resources on this Topic
content: Humana’s Making it Easier web-based training series includes a video on the proper reporting and reimbursement of Home Health Billing that may supplement your understanding of this policy.

sections.heading: Definitions of Italicized Terms
content: • Notice of admission (NOA) : An NOA is a notice for the billing of home health agency claims. This submission is used by Original Medicare to open an episode of care.

sections.heading: General Humana Resources
content: • Availity – Providers can register for access to information on a variety of topics such as eligibility, benefits, referrals, authorizations, claims and electronic remittances. • Claims processing edit notifications – Alerts of upcoming claims payment changes are posted on the first Friday of each month. • Claims resources – Providers can find information on referrals, authorizations, electronic claim submissions and more. • Making it easier – This page contains an educational series for providers and healthcare professionals. • Medical and pharmacy coverage policies – Humana publishes determinations of coverage of medical procedures, devices and medications for the treatment of various conditions. There may be variances in coverage among plans. • Publications – This page can help you find our quarterly newsletter, provider manual and other resources to help you do business with us.
